thread:
maria-support: Heads up — customer reported a spike of 500s + some 401s hitting /v1/generate around 2025-08-12 14:05-14:20 UTC. They also say audit logs for that window are missing from their export and need ISO27001 retention evidence. They want KMS/HSM usage proof for key wrapping during the same window. Request IDs: req_01F5a2, req_01F5a9.

liz-support: Thanks Maria. I asked them for repro steps and sample payloads, they sent a curl snippet and said they saw both 500 and occasional 401. Pasting their curl: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"status check","max_tokens":10}'```

maria-support: They also attached an audit export CSV but the rows for 2025-08-12 14:00-14:20 are empty — just header. They need confirmation of retention policy and whether we have any export gaps.

jneal-sre: Can you paste the exact request IDs and timestamps from the customer CSV? I'll grep the ingestion logs. If we don't have entries, we'll check ingestion and export pipeline (log-forwarder -> s3 export job).

liz-support: Sent IDs in prev message. Timestamps customer provided: 2025-08-12T14:07:12Z (req_01F5a2), 2025-08-12T14:15:49Z (req_01F5a9). They also noted an auth error immediately before the 500s.

jneal-sre: On it. Quick note: the export job rotates hourly and relies on the audit log bucket lifecycle — if the job failed during that hour we'd see missing CSVs. I'll check the export job run logs and S3 object list.

priya-security: FYI we need to collect KMS key usage logs for the customer tenant keys for that timeframe. If they use CMKs we should pull CloudTrail entries showing Decrypt/Encrypt/GenerateDataKey calls; if HSM used, we need HSM audit entries. Also, for ISO27001 evidence, we'll need the retention policy reference, export proof, and key rotation logs.

sam-product: @priya-security can you confirm which internal artifact maps to ISO Annex A controls for retention + cryptographic key evidence? We should give the customer the mapping doc and a short list of artifacts we can provide.

priya-security: I'll pull the mapping. Generally: retention evidence -> our "Audit Log Retention Policy" doc + S3 object manifests (proof of export), and crypto evidence -> CloudTrail KMS events + CMK rotation records + HSM audit if applicable. I'll need the CMK ARNs or customer tenant ID to scope queries.

maria-support: Customer tenant id is acct-8421, CMK observed in tenant metadata is arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01. Asking them to confirm off-channel.

ops-bot: Scheduled job status: audit-export-job-20250812-14 FAILED (exit code 1) on runner-03. Log: "Timeout while writing to s3://redwood-audit-exports/2025/08/12/14.csv".

jneal-sre: Good catch ops-bot — that explains missing CSV. I'll pull runner logs to determine cause of timeout and whether retry created partial object. Also checking if any requests were dropped at ingress due to auth issues around that minute.

liz-support: Customer asked about invoice/billing impact because they saw errors while creating embeddings for billing metering. Any chance this affected billing records?

jneal-sre: Billing metering is decoupled and writes to a separate pipeline; unlikely impacted, but I'll confirm by checking billing-events for acct-8421 in that timeframe.

priya-security: Meanwhile I'll query CloudTrail for KMS events for key/abcd-ef01 between 2025-08-12T14:00:00Z and 2025-08-12T14:30:00Z and export the subset as evidence. If HSM logs needed, I'll open a request to infra to fetch HSM audit bundle.

maria-support: I've told the customer: we're investigating export job failure and will provide: (1) export job run logs + s3 manifest showing missing/partial file, (2) CloudTrail KMS events for their CMK, (3) mapping doc to ISO controls, (4) repro instructions for the 500/401 (they provided curl). Asked for confirmation of CMK ARN off-channel.

sam-product: Recommend we include a short runbook note for the customer explaining: why a transient export job failure could happen, what we do to guarantee retention (retries, replication), and a remediation timeline. I'll draft and share.

liz-support: Customer acknowledges and appreciates quick response, asked for ETA for evidence (they need it for a compliance call tomorrow). Can we prioritize? :pray:

priya-security: I'll prioritize the CloudTrail extract and mapping doc. Expect initial packet within 3 hours. If HSM required, that may add time.

jneal-sre: I'll triage the export job and provide a root-cause note + retry/run re-export if object missing. ETA 2 hours for preliminary findings.

maria-support: Thanks everyone — assigning this a P1 support escalation and emailing the customer with the expected artifacts and ETAs. I'll post updates here as they come. :thumbsup:
